side.description: The order side. ASK = sell, BID = buy.

price.description: The limit price for LIMIT or STOP_LIMIT orders. Required for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT types.

amount.description: The order amount (quantity of the base asset).

stop_price.description: The trigger price for STOP_LIMIT or STOP_MARKET orders.

operator.description: The trigger condition when combined with stop_price. GTE = triggered when price >= stop_price, LTE = triggered when price <= stop_price.

immediate_or_cancel.description: If true, the order must be filled immediately or cancelled. Valid for LIMIT orders only.

post_only.description: If true, the order will only post to the order book as a maker. If it would take liquidity, it is cancelled.

client_order_id.description: A user-specified order ID for tracking and cancellation. Must be unique within 24 hours.
